title: PRD-PKB-15 Production Kanban Entry
summary: Ledgerline screen for managing electronic production kanban cards and triggering container replenishment signals between consuming and feeder work centres.
body:
Screen PRD-PKB-15 manages electronic kanban tracking cards and logs container demand replenishment signals between consuming and feeder work centres at Manchester and Leeds [^r1]. It is accessed from the main menu under Production and Quality via Production > Production kanban [^r5][^r10]. Authorised roles include PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, and SYS-ADMIN [^r10].

## Fields

| Field label | Technical name | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ITEM CD | itm_cd | String | Yes | Approved sub-assembly item code validated against the active BOM [^r2][^r6][^r7][^r10][^r13]. |
| WORK CENTRE | wc_cd | String | Yes | Designated consuming or feeder production line or cell code [^r2][^r6][^r10][^r13]. |
| QTY | qty | Integer | Yes | Standard container batch quantity [^r2][^r6][^r10][^r13]. |
| PKB NO | pkb_no | String | Yes | Kanban ticket or card reference number [^r2][^r8][^r10][^r12][^r15]. |
| COMMENT | comment | String | No | Operational remarks or notes regarding the signal [^r2][^r6][^r10][^r15]. |

## Keys and services

* **Get** (`F3`): Invokes read service `pkb_get` using `pkb_no` to populate the screen with previously recorded work centre and quantity details [^r8][^r11][^r12].
* **Save** (`F8`): Invokes write service `pkb_save` passing `itm_cd`, `wc_cd`, and `qty` to validate the item against the active BOM and generate the electronic kanban record [^r3][^r7][^r11][^r13].
* **Signal**: Invokes write service `pkb_signal` requiring `PKB NO` and optional `COMMENT` to mark an empty container as active, alerting the feeder department that replenishment is due [^r3][^r9][^r11][^r14][^r15].

## Messages

* `[[err-itm-0011]]`: Displayed on the status line when an entered item code is unrecognised, inactive, or not found on the active BOM during `pkb_save` [^r4][^r7][^r11].
* `[[err-pkb-0001]]`: Primary validation error returned on the status line when an empty container signal is rejected because it has already been signalled [^r4][^r9][^r11].
* `[[err-pkb-0201]]`: Displayed on the status line during validation for duplicate active kanban cycles [^r4][^r11].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Mandatory status of PKB NO**: In the field specification sections of MAN-SCR-72 and MAN-PRD-72, `PKB NO` is designated as mandatory [^r2][^r10]. In the MAN-PRD-72 worked example for card creation, `PKB NO` is described as optional, with the user entering an existing reference only if applicable [^r6]. Kind: `contradiction`.

## See also

* `[[services-prd-pkb|PRD pkb services]]`
* `[[screen-prd-wc-10|PRD-WC-10 Work Centre]]`
* `[[screen-prd-bom-02|PRD-BOM-02 Bill Of Materials]]`
* `[[screen-prd-wo-01|PRD-WO-01 Work Order Entry]]`
* `[[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE]]`
* `[[err-pkb-0001|ERR-PKB-0001 Primary Kanban Validation Failure]]`
* `[[err-pkb-0201|ERR-PKB-0201 Duplicate Active Kanban Cycle]]`

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Screen PRD-PKB-15 records the demand signals generated when a consuming work centre empties a container, manages the electronic tracking card associated with that movement

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: itm_cd ITEM CD Yes wc_cd WORK CENTRE Yes qty QTY Yes pkb_no PKB NO Yes comment COMMENT No

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.loc_text: p. 70, Logging a new replenishment signal
r3.quote: To transmit the electronic demand to the supplying area, click the button marked pkb_signal to execute the PRODUCTION KANBAN SIGNAL service.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: The screen displays system messages in the bottom status line of the terminal display. The following entries represent the standard notices generated by the background validation routines:

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Navigate from the main menu into Production and Quality and open screen PRD-PKB-15 'Production Kanban'.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: In the ITEM CD field, enter the approved code for the sub-assembly required by the assembly line.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: Click the button for pkb_save (PRODUCTION KANBAN SAVE). Ledgerline validates the item against the current bill of materials and creates the electronic kanban record.

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: To retrieve an existing entry for review, enter the card reference into the PKB NO field and click the button for pkb_get (PRODUCTION KANBAN GET).

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r9.quote: When the container is empty and replenishment is needed by the line, ensure the record is retrieved and click the button for pkb_signal (PRODUCTION KANBAN SIGNAL).

r10.quote: PRD-PKB-15 PRODUCTION KANBAN ENTRY Menu: Production > Production kanban. Roles: [PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r11.quote: Save F8 pkb_save Get F3 pkb_get Signal pkb_signal Rule or message Code Qty Must Be > 0 ERR-PKB-0201

r12.quote:
service: pkb_get
title: PRODUCTION KANBAN GET
module: PRD
kind: read
screen: PRD-PKB-15

r13.quote: service: pkb_save title: PRODUCTION KANBAN SAVE module: PRD kind: write screen: PRD-PKB-15

r14.quote:
service: pkb_signal
title: PRODUCTION KANBAN SIGNAL
module: PRD
kind: write
screen: PRD-PKB-15

r15.quote:
- {name: pkb_no, type: str, required: true, desc: PKB NO}
  - {name: comment, type: str, required: false, desc: COMMENT}

conflicts.today: Screen definition manuals list PKB NO as mandatory, but the worked example allows it to be optional when creating a new card
conflicts.other: MAN-PRD-72 p. 69 and MAN-SCR-72 p. 24 require PKB NO, whereas MAN-PRD-72 p. 72 treats PKB NO as optional on initial card creation
